situation.narrative: Item-not-received disputes up 4.4x in 7 days, mostly on Northline Parcel.
situation.label: A: one carrier

precedents.title: Wrong tracking numbers uploaded for one carrier
precedents.outcome_summary: Illustrative: corrected tracking was sent to buyers and attached as evidence. No measured numbers.

precedents.title: Regional carrier stopped posting delivery scans
precedents.outcome_summary: Illustrative: with tracking submitted as evidence and delivery confirmation required on that carrier, new disputes on it slowed. No measured numbers.

precedents.title: Carrier could not deliver to PO boxes
precedents.outcome_summary: Illustrative: address validation at checkout and messages to affected buyers. No measured numbers.

precedents.title: Carrier hub outage stranded one lane
precedents.outcome_summary: Illustrative: new orders were routed to another carrier and affected buyers got a status message. No measured numbers.

precedents.title: High-value parcels lost on one carrier's last mile
precedents.outcome_summary: Illustrative: signature confirmation on orders above a value threshold plus tracking evidence on open disputes. No measured numbers.

recommendation.diagnosis_detail: Disputes are 4.4x the 30-day baseline and 83% are item-not-received. 87% of disputes are on Northline Parcel, only 1 carrier is elevated, orders ship in about 10h, and 23% of disputed orders show a delivery scan. That points at the carrier, not the warehouse.

actions.title: File tracking evidence on open item-not-received disputes on Northline Parcel
actions.rationale: Followed in 4 similar case(s). Shared signals: carrier concentration, share of disputed orders delivered, fulfilment delay.

actions.title: Require delivery confirmation on Northline Parcel shipments

params.note: Turn on signature or photo confirmation for Northline Parcel until its scans recover.
